successCriteria.description: `AuditService` class exists in `src/modules/audit/audit.service.ts`, implements `IAuditService`, and its constructor accepts the shared `pool` (imported from `src/shared/db/connection.ts`) — not `IAuditRepository`.

`AuditService.record()` executes `INSERT INTO audit_records` via the shared pool, using `gen_random_uuid()` for `id`, `NOW()` for `created_at`, and a `RETURNING` clause with snake_case→camelCase column aliases (`entity_type AS "entityType"`, `entity_id AS "entityId"`, `performed_by AS "performedBy"`, `created_at AS "createdAt"`), and returns the inserted `AuditRecord`.
`src/modules/audit/index.ts` barrel exports exactly three symbols: `AuditRecord`, `IAuditService`, `AuditService`. It does NOT export `IAuditRepository` or `AuditRepository`.
`src/shared/types/index.ts` exports `AuditAction` enum (already present; verified). No changes needed to this file — the barrel already satisfies the requirement.
The project compiles cleanly: `npm run build` (which runs `tsc --noEmit` equivalent) passes with zero type errors.

constraints: No `any` types anywhere in the implementation — use `unknown` with type guards if needed (HARNESS constraint `no-any`).
TypeScript strict mode: `strict: true`, `target: ES2022`, `module: commonjs`, `rootDir: ./src`, `outDir: ./dist` per `tsconfig.json`.

The reconciled architecture (`.gestalt/architecture/reconciled.json`) is authoritative: the audit module has NO repository. `AuditService` takes `pool` directly and performs its own SQL. This overrides HARNESS constraint `no-direct-db-outside-repository` and GP-001 for the audit module specifically.
The `record` method must use parameterized queries (`$1, $2, ...`) — never string interpolation — for all values passed to the SQL statement.
outOfScope: Unit tests for the audit module — these are produced in "Sub-phase 3: Unit tests for employee and audit modules". Do not create `tests/unit/modules/audit/audit.service.test.ts` or any other test file.
Employee module implementation (`employee.repository.ts`, `employee.service.ts`, `employee/index.ts`) — these are produced in "Sub-phase 1: Employee module implementation".

Creation or modification of `IAuditRepository`, `AuditRepository`, or `audit.repository.interface.ts` / `audit.repository.ts` — these are artifacts of a prior design being replaced. The audit module must NOT use a repository.
Database migration for the `audit_records` table — the table is assumed to exist. This phase only implements the service that inserts into it.

entityInvariants.invariant: Every `AuditRecord` inserted by `AuditService.record()` must have `id` generated server-side via `gen_random_uuid()` and `createdAt` set to the database's `NOW()` — the caller provides neither field (matching the `Omit<AuditRecord, 'id' | 'createdAt'>` input type).

interfaceConstraints.authRule: No auth enforcement at this layer — the audit service is a passive recorder called by other services; the caller is responsible for providing the correct `performedBy` value.
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: If the database insert fails (e.g., constraint violation, connection error), the promise rejects with the underlying error — the service does not swallow or transform errors.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: `AuditService` must import `pool` from `src/shared/db/connection.ts` — the same singleton `Pool` instance used by all other modules. No separate connection or pool creation.

`AuditService` must implement `IAuditService` from `./audit.service.interface.ts` — the `record` method signature must match exactly: `record(record: Omit<AuditRecord, 'id' | 'createdAt'>): Promise<AuditRecord>`.

integrationPoints.why: AuditService imports the shared `pool` singleton for all database operations.
